info.name: OHM Backend API - Root and Tenant
info.description: Requests are grouped by identity and schema. Public / Shared needs no account. Root / Super Admin uses a public-schema token and omits X-Tenant. Tenant Workspace uses a tenant token and X-Tenant: {{tenantSlug}}. Tenant Owner Portal uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token and omits X-Tenant. Account APIs include the merged Vaishnavi Medicare employee, customer, shift, document, and staff-for-hire endpoints.

item.name: 00 - Public / Shared
item.description: No login required unless the endpoint says otherwise.

item.name: Health check
item.description: Returns {status, schema}. Does not verify tenant routing.

item.name: List active plans
item.description: Public: lists active plans. Root admins see all plans in the Root / Super Admin section.

item.name: Check tenant slug
item.description: Checks tenant subdomain availability. Query slug is required.

item.name: Create onboarding request
item.description: Public applicant endpoint. Does not require a root or tenant login.

item.name: 01 - ROOT / SUPER ADMIN (public schema)
item.description: Platform control-plane APIs. Use the root/platform login and do not send X-Tenant.

item.name: 00 - Root / platform schema authentication
item.description: Use a platform-schema account. Omit X-Tenant for root/platform APIs and the tenant-owner portal. Login responses save tokens to rootAccessToken/rootRefreshToken.

item.name: Login with password (public schema)
item.description: Unified login. Tenant account: include X-Tenant; platform admin: omit it.

item.name: Request login OTP (public schema)
item.description: Returns 202 with a generic detail regardless of account existence. OTP expires in five minutes; delivery depends on email/SMS configuration.

item.name: Login with OTP (public schema)
item.description: Use the six digit login OTP.

item.name: Request password-reset OTP (public schema)
item.description: Request a password-reset code. Include X-Tenant for tenant accounts; omit for root.

item.name: Reset password (public schema)
item.description: Consumes one password_reset OTP and changes the password. Django password validators apply.

item.name: Refresh access token (public schema)
item.description: SimpleJWT token refresh. Rotation is enabled; save returned refresh value when present.

item.name: Logout / blacklist refresh token (public schema)
item.description: Requires access token. Blacklists the supplied refresh token; current access JWT remains valid until expiry.

item.name: 01 - Provider onboarding review (Root / Super Admin)
item.description: Platform staff only. The public application request is under Public / Shared.

item.name: List requests (platform admin)
item.description: Platform admin only. Optional status filter.

item.name: Get request (platform admin)
item.description: Platform admin only. X-Onboarding-Token is not honored by current code.

item.name: Edit submitted request
item.description: Platform admin only; only submitted requests may be edited.

item.name: Approve and enqueue provisioning
item.description: Platform admin only; submitted requests only. Returns 202. Requires a running Celery worker to provision.

item.name: Reject request
item.description: Platform admin only; submitted requests only; review_notes is required and non-empty.

item.name: Retry provisioning
item.description: Platform admin only; approved request with a provisioning error only.

item.name: Delete request
item.description: Platform admin only; submitted or rejected request without linked tenant. Returns 204.

item.name: 02 - Platform tenant administration (Root / Super Admin)
item.description: Platform Admin only; operates in the public/platform schema.

item.name: List tenants
item.description: Public tenant excluded. ?status=active and ?search=clinic are supported.

query.description: Search name, schema, contact email, domain.
Search name, schema, contact email, domain.

item.name: Create tenant directly
item.description: Creates schema directly in ACTIVE status; domain optional and primary. Distinct from approval-driven onboarding.

item.name: Get tenant
item.description: Platform admin only.

item.name: Update tenant
item.description: Writable fields: name, owner, modules, logo, contact_email, contact_phone, timezone, tags, default_currency.

item.name: Suspend tenant
item.description: Only active tenants can be suspended; middleware blocks tenant requests while suspended.

item.name: Activate tenant
item.description: Only suspended tenants can be reactivated.

item.name: Delete tenant schema
item.description: Destructive. Tenant must be suspended and confirm must exactly match schema_name. Permanently drops schema/data; returns 204.

item.name: Get tenant app permissions
item.description: Lists the active feature catalogue and enabled state for the tenant. Root platform admin; omit X-Tenant.

item.name: Update tenant app permissions
item.description: Replace enabled_modules with active feature codes from the GET response.

item.name: List tenant object permissions
item.description: Lists available object types, tenant roles, and existing object-scoped role grants.

item.name: Grant tenant object permission
item.description: Grant a tenant role to a tenant user for one object. Set tenantUserId to a user ID from this tenant and use an existing object_type/object_id.

item.name: Revoke tenant object permission
item.description: Removes the object-scoped grant identified by objectPermissionAssignmentId.

query.description: Grant ID returned by Grant tenant object permission.

item.name: 03 - Plans and subscriptions (Root / Super Admin)
item.description: Plan mutations and subscription management require a Platform Admin token. Public plan listing is under Public / Shared.

item.name: Create plan
item.description: Writes use feature_ids; returned representation includes features.

item.name: Update plan
item.description: Plan deletion when in use returns 409; deactivate it instead.

item.name: Delete plan
item.description: Platform admin only; 204 if unused, 409 if referenced by tenants.

item.name: Create subscription
item.description: starts_at required; ends_at must be after starts_at. Response includes plan_name.

item.name: Get subscription
item.description: Platform admin only.

item.name: Update subscription
item.description: Partial update of subscription fields.

item.name: Delete subscription
item.description: Platform admin only; returns 204.

item.name: List subscriptions
item.description: Optional filters: tenant, plan, status.

item.name: 02 - TENANT WORKSPACE (X-Tenant required)
item.description: Workspace APIs. Use tenant login and set tenantSlug to the workspace slug.

item.name: 00 - Tenant workspace authentication
item.description: Use a tenant account. Set tenantSlug before sending requests; X-Tenant selects the workspace. Login responses save tokens to tenantAccessToken/tenantRefreshToken.

item.name: Login with password (tenant schema)
item.description: Unified login. Tenant account: include X-Tenant; platform admin: omit it.

item.name: Request login OTP (tenant schema)
item.description: Returns 202 with a generic detail regardless of account existence. OTP expires in five minutes; delivery depends on email/SMS configuration.

item.name: Login with OTP (tenant schema)
item.description: Use the six digit login OTP.

item.name: Request password-reset OTP (tenant schema)
item.description: Request a password-reset code. Include X-Tenant for tenant accounts; omit for root.

item.name: Reset password (tenant schema)
item.description: Consumes one password_reset OTP and changes the password. Django password validators apply.

item.name: Refresh access token (tenant schema)
item.description: SimpleJWT token refresh. Rotation is enabled; save returned refresh value when present.

item.name: Logout / blacklist refresh token (tenant schema)
item.description: Requires access token. Blacklists the supplied refresh token; current access JWT remains valid until expiry.

item.name: 01 - Customer registration (Tenant)
item.description: Public registration inside a tenant; X-Tenant is required.

item.name: Register customer
item.description: Register a customer in the current tenant. email and password are required; name fields and mobile_number are optional.

item.name: 02 - Workspace users (Tenant Admin)
item.description: Tenant Admin only. Requires a tenant token and X-Tenant: {{tenantSlug}}.

item.name: List workspace users
item.description: Optional filters role=TENANT_ADMIN|CUSTOMER and q for email/name substring.

query.description: Case-insensitive email or full name search.
Case-insensitive email or full name search.

item.name: Create workspace user
item.description: Create a workspace user with first_name, middle_name, last_name, mobile_number, password, and an optional role (defaults to CUSTOMER).

item.name: Get workspace user
item.description: Retrieve a tenant user.

item.name: Update workspace user
item.description: Email cannot be changed. Password in updates is ignored. Cannot deactivate yourself or remove the last active Tenant Admin.

item.name: 03 - Owners and co-owners (Tenant)
item.description: Tenant workspace owner management. Requires X-Tenant: {{tenantSlug}}.

item.name: 05 - Medicare account APIs
item.description: Tenant account management APIs merged from Vaishnavi Medicare. Requests use X-Tenant and tenantAccessToken unless marked public.

item.name: Bulk employee upload
item.description: Upload an .xlsx or .xlsm file (up to 10 MB; maximum 1,000 employees).

item.name: 04 - Roles and assignments (Tenant Admin)
item.description: Tenant Admin only. Requires X-Tenant: {{tenantSlug}}.

item.name: Create role
item.description: Creates a custom role and saves its ID as roleId. Choose a unique code for each workspace.

item.name: Delete role
item.description: Delete a custom role after removing all role assignments.

item.name: Assign role to user
item.description: Creates a tenant-wide role grant and saves the assignment ID as assignmentId.

item.name: Assign role to user on object
item.description: Optional object-scoped grant. Change object_type and object_id to a real object in this tenant.

item.name: Revoke role assignment
item.description: Removes the selected role grant. The last active Tenant Admin grant cannot be removed.

item.name: 03 - TENANT OWNER PORTAL (platform schema)
item.description: Tenant owners edit and activate their tenant profile here. Authenticate with the owner account in the public/platform schema; omit X-Tenant.

item.name: List my tenants
item.description: Uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token; omit X-Tenant.

item.name: Get my tenant
item.description: Retrieve one owned tenant. Uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token; omit X-Tenant.

item.name: Update my tenant profile
item.description: Editable: name, contact_email, contact_phone, timezone, tags, default_currency, logo. Activation requires name/contact_email/contact_phone/timezone/default_currency. Uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token; omit X-Tenant.

item.name: Activate my tenant
item.description: Owner can activate only a provisioning tenant after required profile fields are complete. Uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token; omit X-Tenant.

item.name: Update profile (multipart, logo)
item.description: Uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token; omit X-Tenant.
